business_problem: Mapfre wanted to improve customer experience and streamline insurance operations such as claims handling, risk assessment, underwriting support, document management, internal knowledge access, and digital content creation while keeping AI use governed responsibly.
solution_summary: Mapfre describes a portfolio of in-house and partner-supported AI systems embedded across insurance operations. Inputs include customer emails, vehicle damage images captured during policy issuance, claims data, rehabilitation information, insured-portfolio risk data, cyber-risk signals for SMEs, and internal knowledge sources such as product sheets, conditioning factors, and operations content. Processing is handled through deep learning, generative AI, and partner solutions including Shift for end-to-end home-claims automation in Brazil, ControlExpert for real-time vehicle-damage verification, Trak for AI-supported digital physiotherapy, Lobelia for climate-risk prediction, Cyberwrite for cyber-risk assessment, and MIA GPT for agency query resolution. Outputs are served into claims payments, underwriting and risk workflows, employee assistance, customer interactions, and digital marketing content. Governance is enforced through Mapfre's group AI governance model and Holistic AI for transparency, fairness, and risk mitigation.

solution_components.name: MIA GPT
solution_components.role: Virtual assistant that answers agency-network questions on topics such as conditioning factors, product sheets, and operations.

solution_components.name: Shift
solution_components.role: Supports end-to-end AI automation for home insurance claims processing in Mapfre Brazil, including validation that enables direct payment in a single interaction.

solution_components.name: ControlExpert
solution_components.role: Provides a deep learning algorithm for automatic real-time verification of car damage when taking out a policy.

solution_components.name: Trak
solution_components.role: Supports Mapfre España's digital physiotherapy initiative for prescribed rehabilitation exercises and continuous patient monitoring.

solution_components.name: Lobelia
solution_components.role: Helps Mapfre RE predict the impact of climate change on the physical risks of insured portfolios.

solution_components.name: Cyberwrite
solution_components.role: Powers a cyberprotection pilot for SMEs to assess vulnerabilities and improve cyberinsurance underwriting risk knowledge.

solution_components.name: Holistic AI
solution_components.role: Provides AI governance capabilities to identify and mitigate risks while improving transparency and fairness.

data_flow: Mapfre ingests customer emails, vehicle images, claims information, internal agency knowledge, and portfolio or cyber-risk data into AI services. Deep-learning and generative-AI components classify, verify, predict, or answer questions, then feed results into claims validation and payment, underwriting and risk assessment, rehabilitation monitoring, internal agency support, and digital content publishing.
integration_points: Vehicle images captured during policy issuance
Agency knowledge sources including conditioning factors, product sheets, and operations content
Digital platforms, social networks, and search engines
business_outcome: Mapfre reports faster and more effective responses, streamlined internal and customer-facing processes, automated claims handling, stronger risk analysis, and improved digital engagement and satisfaction. Generative AI also increased visibility and traffic to digital channels.
